bucket_note: RIDOT's statewide crash repository became a public record in June 2026 (RIGL 38-2-17, 2026-H 7576 / S 2480, effective on passage), but there is still no portal, open layer or download: records come by APRA request (or, for RIDOT projects, from the RIDOT Office of Safety). Verified live 2026-11-08.
bucket_2026_11_02: D (confirmed; the 2026 law changed the right to the data, not the access)

user_actions: File a request on RIDOT's APRA portal (https://www.dot.ri.gov/business/publicrecordsrequest.php) for the statewide crash repository 2021-2025 plus 2026 to date: crash, vehicle/unit and person tables, the field dictionary/code tables, and latitude/longitude. Ask for CSV.
In the same request, ask whether RIDOT will publish the data online (open portal) and whether use in a paid engineering tool is allowed beyond the 23 U.S.C. 407 limit.
Send one delivered file (or one town, one year) so the column map can be checked and a reader built.
